description: This file is a Yocto Project .inc file used to define build configurations, dependencies, and packaging instructions for the ncurses library, including source retrieval, compilation, testing, and installation steps.

methods.name: ncurses_configure
methods.description: Helper function to run the configuration script in a specified directory with arguments for ncurses

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Overrides the default autotools configure step to prepare environment and run specific configuration for ncurses

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the ncurses library, including optional widecharacter support

methods.name: do_test
methods.description: Tests the compatibility of narrowc and widec header files for ncurses

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the ncurses build, including runtime files, headers, and creates necessary linker scripts and symlinks
